note: Your report (8 Oct): where the buildings meet the terrain, the edges are super wobbly. The wobbles keep changing while the camera moves, so the edges look jittery in motion.
reply: Fixed, holding still and in motion; it ships with B3's publish. Cause: on the globe (below zoom 16.5) MapLibre places the terrain and the buildings using low-precision numbers, so every vertex is off by 1–2 m, a different way each frame. A patch to MapLibre now places both from the same corner points, so they move together. Before/after frames from Honolulu and Barcelona: scratchpad/b3/shots/ (S1.gif, S2.gif). The build fails loudly if a MapLibre update stops the patch applying.
